_about: Everything the app needs OUTSIDE the database dump, so a rebuild on another Supabase project misses nothing. Checked against the code by `npm run migration:check`. Update this file whenever an API route, cron, env var or storage bucket is added, removed or renamed.

crons.note: daily 03:30 UTC (09:00 IST). If CRON_SECRET is set the route requires header Authorization: Bearer <CRON_SECRET> (Vercel Cron sends it automatically); if unset the route is open. Reads Supabase through VITE_SUPABASE_URL / VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY on the server.

known_gaps.expense-reports: Referenced by code (report PDF upload and Audit Trail) but has never existed on the live project, so those uploads fail quietly. Copied as-is for an exact replica. Creating the bucket on the new project would make report PDFs start saving: a deliberate behaviour change, decide before cutover.
known_gaps.feedback-screenshots: Exists with 2 files but no code uses it any more (feedback widget removed). Copied for completeness.

nucleus_intake_proxy.why: Decided on 2026-11-02: the Nucleus integration is not being carried over.
nucleus_intake_proxy.left_in_database: purchase_requests.source and vendors.source (default 'app'); only drives a 'Submitted through Nucleus' tag. Harmless, copied.

supabase_managed_not_copied: extensions pg_stat_statements, supabase_vault (already present on every project)
